title: Site
description: Site-wide metadata — the roster page's title and the footer shown on every page. Individual actors are not listed here; every file in content/actors/ is picked up automatically.

$schema.description: Path to this schema file, for editor autocomplete. Not used at runtime.

name.description: The site's name, shown in the browser tab and on the roster page, e.g. "Menon & Das Casting".

description.description: A one-line description used as the roster page's subtitle and its meta description tag.

footer.description: Shown at the bottom of every page. Omit entirely to hide the footer.

copyrightName.description: The name shown after the copyright year, e.g. "Priya Menon" or an agency name.

socials.description: Site-wide social links (as opposed to an individual actor's, which live on their own profile).
